gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-trocchi: Stencil-cut and cheeky, Happy Monkey draws every letter at a single width, while Trocchi, a text serif, brings mild thick-thin variation and a ringlike c. They make a dressed-up, playful page.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-trykker: Happy Monkey writes with a pen-like line that never changes weight, while Trykker follows with modest contrast, like lightly engraved brass lettering. Paragraphs feel literary and unhurried.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-vollkorn-sc: Chunky, ring-shaped o's and rigid strokes give Happy Monkey its swagger. Vollkorn SC, a text serif, does the quieter work, with slight stroke modulation and loosely tracked lines that let a paragraph unwind.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-yuji-syuku: Yuji Syuku is a dignified serif with open spacing and curved strokes that end before they turn inward. Yuji Syuku's weight shifts only slightly, like brushed watercolor, which is a gentle foil to the dowel-straight stems of Happy Monkey.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-ibm-plex-serif: Happy Monkey sets plain constant-width lines up top, bold and a bit unusual, with wide gaps in its e. And IBM Plex Serif follows with moderate contrast, so a long page reads steadily and with authority.
gen-gf-headland-one-gf-cascadia-code: Refined and classic, Headland One has tall-bowled letters with a light, close-up modulation. And Cascadia Code, a wire-like monoline with generous distance between neighbors, gives the pair its sharpest quality: a lively difference of texture.
gen-gf-headland-one-gf-cascadia-mono: Tall bowls and a whisper of contrast give Headland One a polished, old-world look. Cascadia Mono, a sans-serif, stands in pin-straight letters with curves as thick as its stems, so nothing pulses and the eye glides.
gen-gf-headland-one-gf-julius-sans-one: Julius Sans One reads as a spacious sans-serif, with open-ended curves and almost no gap between capital and lowercase height. And Headland One above it keeps a soft, restrained thick-thin ratio, like ink traces.
gen-gf-headland-one-gf-lexend-exa: Headland One leads with generous openings and a light modulation you notice mainly up close. Lexend Exa follows in tubular strokes like bent copper pipe, with stubby ascenders next to a big x-height.
gen-gf-headland-one-gf-lexend-giga: Headland One brings tall bowls and gentle contrast. Lexend Giga counters with flat, single-weight lines cut from one gauge of tubing, and generous tracking that opens up every word.
